name: judge
purpose: Catches regressions: record questions and answers once, then after any change replay them on the live Brainstem and a teacher grades each new answer against the original (same, better, worse, broken), with a side-by-side report.

parts.what: The one provider part: Responses-API-only models (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna) and this machine's Ollama models (ollama/<name>, tools included) in the unchanged grail. responses_models and local_models are aliases of this part (status: alias; still served, not seeded).
Every chat turn (plain and streamed) is recorded in the Brainstem Journal on this device, by default; pause it from chat. No journal running: nothing happens.

install.parts_note: rapp-rar-stack/1.2: this distro runs on the unchanged grail with these grail layers seeded over it (same bytes and sha256 as stacks/grail-layers; the supervisor applies them in memory, probes /chat, and falls back to plain grail). The distro's own agents install beside them.
